clay.delta: Refine CLAY-L4 into OPEN CLAY-L5 candidate by separating continuous latent cognition/communication from effect/physical runtime; preserve one canonical semantic spine with multiple reader/cognition projections.
clay.evidence_class: peer-reviewed + external preprint + internal proxy/negative result

frank.delta: FRANK C6 should expose DISCRETE_NATIVE and LATENT_NATIVE as separately versioned proposal/cognition channels while retaining ICSL/canonical Clay and the external capability/effect gateway.
frank.evidence_class: cross-branch synthesis with independent ACL/ICLR/agent-language evidence
frank.next_experiment: Target Qwen 4B NL vs canonical vs learned-symbol vs latent vs hybrid factorial

gwt.delta: Add broadcast representation/medium as an orthogonal causal factor. Global availability must be tested independently of whether workspace content is human-readable, discrete-native or latent.
gwt.evidence_class: mechanism transfer from Interlat/Semantic Hub + existing GWT orthogonality

emergenz.delta: Extend E-CERT2 channel interventions to latent messages and population conventions. Neither codebook purity, protocol convergence nor latent performance gain is sufficient emergence evidence.
emergenz.evidence_class: causal-audit preprint + peer-reviewed population convention evidence + internal null
emergenz.next_experiment: Latent message substitution plus convention lesion/rescue/OOD tests

claycode.delta: CC-RC1.5 ICSL is independently strengthened by COVENANT/SIGIL/FAVA/ETAS/PCAA. Add explicit contracts for NativeSymbolReceipt and LatentChannelReceipt; canonical correctness remains separate from reader optimization.
claycode.next_experiment: Target-reader factorial and safe lowering tests across P2/P3 projections

hyperposition.delta: H4 semantic firebreak becomes representation-aware: canonical class, discrete-native view and latent-native state may co-refer but may not implicitly cast truth/authority/effect across planes.
hyperposition.evidence_class: external representation evidence + current H4 firebreak architecture
hyperposition.next_experiment: Cross-plane alias/cascade tests with stale codebook and misaligned latent bridge

claygraph.delta: Persist canonical semantics and ancestry, not raw latent state as truth. Store codebook/latent projection version hashes, semantic anchors and causal receipts; allow local calibrated semantic-neighborhood retrieval without assuming universal latent geometry.
claygraph.evidence_class: ICLR semantic-hub evidence + calibrated 2026 convergence critique + internal ancestry rules
claygraph.next_experiment: Codebook drift + cross-model latent bridge invalidation/reprojection test
